A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities so the fractional parts are in a compatible form for subtraction, including finding a common denominator, converting equivalent fractions, rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n, or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator before subtracting.
Tag when a fraction is converted to an equivalent fraction with the new denominator.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to match a fractional denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to a standard mixed number before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag simple subtraction of already-aligned whole or fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole-number parts of mixed numbers or rewritten whole numbers.
Tag when the solution separately subtracts whole and fractional parts in a mixed-number problem.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-finding or rewriting steps used to prepare the numbers.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification of the final result.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup by taking 1 from the whole-number part and converting it to denominator-over-denominator in the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed 1 is converted to n/n and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when subtraction is then recomputed using the regrouped fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0/n unless a later borrowing step occurs.
Do not tag final simplification or combining of already-computed parts.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed difference to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is rewritten as 0 or when a zero fractional part is removed.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed number or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag denominator alignment or normalization steps.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite fractional quantities into compatible forms for subtraction, including finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole number as a quantity with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to align with a fractional or mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are rewritten to share a denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag pure normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 4/3 to 3 1/3; that is S02.
Do not tag the actual subtraction step after forms are already aligned.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part as an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution changes a form like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part.
Tag when this normalization is done to either the minuend or subtrahend before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that is S04.
Do not tag combining final whole and fractional parts into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of like-denominator fractions.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers without borrowing yet.
Tag when the solution performs the post-conversion subtraction after an LCD step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory rewriting such as finding an LCD or rewriting a whole number as 0/n; that is S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that is S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part; that is S04.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup when the fractional part would be negative, then simplify or express the final result in lowest terms, integer form, or mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to n/n to continue subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when the solution reduces 0/n to 0 or combines the final whole and fractional parts into the reported answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial alignment steps such as LCD finding or rewriting a whole as 0/n; that is S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction; that is S02.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction that does not involve regrouping or final simplification.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities so the fractional parts are in a compatible form for subtraction, including finding a common denominator, rewriting a whole number with a zero fractional part, or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or converts fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed form such as n + 0/d to align with a fraction or mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for direct subtraction when denominators are already the same and no rewriting occurs.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction of whole parts or numerators after forms are already aligned.
Do not tag for simplification of the final result.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once forms are compatible, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed-number expressions when no borrowing is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators.
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number or whole-number expression without regrouping.
Tag when a step computes a zero fractional or zero whole result as part of the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators or rewrite numbers into compatible forms.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag for simplification or final recombination alone.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to d/d or equivalent fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after an initial negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is combined with the existing fractional part before completing the fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for merely rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d before any need to borrow is addressed.
Do not tag for simplification after the regrouped subtraction is finished.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when 0/d is rewritten as 0 or a whole number plus 0 fraction is expressed as an integer.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or fraction form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or rewriting inputs before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping steps unless the step also explicitly states the final simplified form.
